Analyze:

## Designation and Scope
As a designated Significant Data Fiduciary (SDF) serving over 50 million citizens, HealthNet India processes highly sensitive biometric and genetic data.

## Global Infrastructure
To leverage cheaper cloud computing rates, HealthNet India actively mirrors and permanently stores all raw citizen biometric databases in our offshore data centers located in non-whitelisted jurisdictions outside of India.

## Security Protocols
We employ AES-256 encryption across all network endpoints to secure data in transit.
